item.title: Saja Kilani on <i>The Voice Of Hind Rajab:</i> "Listening to her voice wasn’t easy, but through it we felt her love and courage"
item.description: Oscar and Golden Globe nominated, <i>The Voice Of Hind Rajab</i> tells the harrowing story of how a young child and six other members of her family were murdered in Gaza by the IDF. One of its stars, Saja Kilani, talks about feeling Hind’s love and courage while filming; her own family history; the bond between Ireland and Palestine; and the importance of Arab people telling their own stories.

item.title: On this day in 1993: The Cranberries released <i>Everybody Else Is Doing It, So Why Can't We?</i>
item.description: On March 1, 1993, The Cranberries released their debut album, <i>Everybody Else Is Doing It, So Why Can't We?</i> Produced by Stephen Street, the album – featuring classic tracks like 'Dreams' and 'Linger' – went on to sell millions of copies worldwide, and topped the charts in both Ireland and the UK. To mark its anniversary, we're revisiting a special interview with Noel Hogan.
